title: skills: objectstack-automation's readonly-field callout says "Set runAs: 'system'" without the limit a button-started autolaunched flow has (it answers 403), now that the lint fix line states it
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgU7jN46DmQ6XFvz28s

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` line of PR #32736 (`Part of #32666`); product PRs never edit `skills/**`.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane, once PR #32736 is merged.

## 维护者速读

PR #32736 把 `flow-update-readonly-field` 的修复提示改了：按钮启动的 `autolaunched` 流程声明 `runAs: 'system'` 会被启动准入以 403 拒绝，所以提示改为指向 `screen` / `api` 流程或 `subflow` 节点。技能文档 objectstack-automation 的「写只读字段？设 `runAs: 'system'`」一段仍只给出旧的一句话，AI 照抄就会写出一个按钮点了报 403 的流程。这张卡把那段补上同一个限制。

## Business reason

`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (about line 158 on `main`) reads: "**Writing a `readonly` field? Set `runAs: 'system'`.**" and stops there. `flowStartRefusal` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts`) refuses a non-system caller an elevated `autolaunched`, `record_change` or `schedule` flow with 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` at every door that starts a flow by name, and `autolaunched` is the type a record action button starts. After PR #32736 the lint fix line and `os explain flow-update-readonly-field` both name the routes a button can reach; the skill is the remaining surface that teaches the dead-end remedy to an agent writing metadata.

## Work

1. In the callout, add the limit in one sentence: a flow a user starts from a button or action is elevated only as a `screen` or `api` flow declared `runAs: 'system'`, or by a user-run flow's `subflow` node calling the elevated flow. Use the wording of `os explain flow-update-readonly-field` after #32736, not a new phrasing.
2. Check the skill's evals that grade readonly writes or `runAs` (grep `runAs` under the skill's evals) still grade the rule.
3. Pay for any added line with a removal, per the skills line ratchet.

## Acceptance

The callout states the limit and both routes; `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` green.

## Dedupe

`readonly runAs system skill automation is:issue is:open` → 6, none but #32666 a card, and #32666 is the decision on the reverse-order half, not this sentence.

Blocked-by: #32736
